note: tapFrac is [x, y] normalised SCREEN coordinates with the origin TOP-LEFT. UI taps come from each control's own anchor inside DefaultPanel/Content, corrected for the template's AspecterSA AspectRatioFitter: it fits a 1242x2688 rect (0.46205) inside the 1080x2400 device (0.45), so the UI layer is letterboxed 31.3 px top and bottom and a UGUI anchor a maps to screen y = 0.986958 - a*0.973917. World taps need no correction - the orthographic camera owns the whole screen - so they are computed straight from the hex centres, taking the midpoint of the 16:9 and 19.5:9 solutions; the accept radius is 0.56 of a hex, roughly ten times the spread between those two. Steps 6 and 7 hit the two ANCHOR cells, which LatticeGenerator guarantees hold a mirror in every level it can produce, so the taps are meaningful whatever seed the device rolls. Each loader wait uses waitLoader because both scenes raise their own splash.
